precedence.label: CUDA_PERSISTENCE_POLICY_UNQUALIFIED
precedence.when: policy receipt or isolated engineering qualification does not close

precedence.label: MECHANISM_REQUIREMENTS_READY_FOR_DESIGN_REVIEW
precedence.when: at least one primary natural target has MATERIAL_TIMING_BENEFIT, MATERIAL_DRAM_BENEFIT, and TARGET_SPECIFIC support; requirement extraction also matches evidence

precedence.label: TARGETED_PERSISTENCE_TRAFFIC_ONLY
precedence.when: no target satisfies the ready rule, but at least one primary natural target has MATERIAL_DRAM_BENEFIT

precedence.label: TARGETED_PERSISTENCE_MECHANISM_PRECONDITION_NOT_SUPPORTED
precedence.when: policy is qualified but neither prior evidence rule holds (including timing-only without material DRAM)
